watch.summary: The streamer watches a GTA 6 cutscene and suddenly notices an unexpected audio echo issue during the dialogue.

beats.what: Streamer comments on a character's voice and appearance in the cutscene.
The cutscene dialogue plays as characters talk at the door.
Streamer pauses talking as he notices the audio doubling up.
Streamer realizes and points out that the audio is echoing.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedy is very minimal, coming only from the streamer noticing an unexpected audio glitch mid-reaction. It functions more as an observational technical fault than an intended joke.
